copy.tagline: 用预设网格和配色快速创建视觉版面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速套用固定网格和品牌色做设计
copy.tagline_en: Create visual layouts with preset grids and colors
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply fixed grids and brand colors to your designs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 将内容排版成单文件 HTML 幻灯片：16 列网格、单一 accent 色、22 种固定版式之一，直角无装饰，数据按真实比例作图。
howto.when: 当你要做演示文稿，内容偏向事实、产品、分析或方法论时触发；也可主动指定这四种配色之一。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude formats your content into a single-file HTML slideshow: 16-column grid, one saturated accent color, one of 22 fixed layouts, right angles only, no decoration, and charts reflect real data proportions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a presentation or slides, especially for factual, product, analysis, or methodology content, or when you specify one of the four accent themes.

say_en.text: Make a product roadmap presentation in Swiss International style.
say_en.note: Generates a single-file HTML slideshow on a 16-column grid.
